title: How to find the creepy SOS island in GTA 6 🏝️
description:
Credit: TypicalGamer (Twitch) https://www.twitch.tv/typicalgamer/clip/LightHungryStinkbugRitzMitz--9h2hfQUsrxODcRm
A tiny island in GTA 6 hides a phone with a couple's last video on it. How to find it:
1. Take a boat from the west coast of Mariana County out into Leonida Bay.
2. Look for a tiny island with a few palm trees and SOS spelled out on the beach. Send beer is written nearby.
3. Find the phone lying in the sand next to the SOS and play the video.
Then you watch a couple filming on the island until something off camera startles them and the recording cuts out. What happened to them is still unsolved.

Would you go out to this island alone? 👇

Sources: Duuro Plays, Leonida List (checked 27 Nov 2026). Narration: AI voice.
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games. Gameplay credit: TypicalGamer.
